records.rawDisplayText:
We finished session 1 and things happened a little bit differently than expected. director seldon is dead, killed by An-Yin as the party tried to point him towards An-Yin, and they fought An-Yin as a result. 

They won, and An-Yin retreated, leaving a silence spell behind. Anara, Toy Soldier, and Brad were affected, and I ended the session describing the horrible feeling of hearing their insides and flesh. 

Can you update the front? I think step 1 is done, and unfortunately step 2 has already started as I accidentally shared that instruments had been falling silent. 

Maybe the city goes into full blown panic now, so we say that that's step 1 (combined with the attack on the party) step 2 is An-Yin dropping any pretense and wanton silencing all noise he can get his hands on, and  step 3 is An-Yin doing the final corruption of the bell. 

I think that's ok given how short this campaign should be?
